raw_response:
Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (white-out) of the left hemithorax with a significant mediastinal shift to the right, which is the classic radiographic appearance of a massive pleural effusion pushing structures away from the affected side. In a patient with bronchiectasis, this is highly suggestive of an empyema or large parapneumonic effusion.
